rationale: Lycopolitan compound preposition, possibly ϩⲁⲣⲱⲥ̄ 'before/concerning her' or ϩⲁ-ⲣⲁⲧⲥ̄ 'at her foot.' Used here in clause 'utter blasphemy ⲍⲁⲣⲡⲧⲥ̄ ⲛⲟⲩⲁ' — 'utter blasphemy concerning her.'
Possibly Greek loanword βάναυσος 'common, mechanical, vulgar' or related Coptic term for the ordinary/mass. Modifies ⲡⲧⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛⲧⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'the unity of humanity' in this kephalaion's polemic.

proposed_english: prevail in measure / master the proportion
rationale: Compound on ⲇⲣⲟ 'prevail' (in glossary) + ⲧⲟ̄ⲁⲧ 'equality/proportion' (in glossary). 'He who shall master the measure' as a juridical-cosmological designation.
Plural noun in negative-moral catalogue with archonic defilements and demons. Possibly Lyc. for ⲱⲁⲓⲉ 'misdeed' or related calamity-noun. Confidence low.

Unidentified lexeme. Likely a noun for 'evil/calamity' qualifying ⲇⲁⲓⲙⲱⲛ 'demons'; numeral reading (=17) less plausible given the syntactic parallelism with ⲛ̄ⲥⲁⲧⲁⲛⲁⲥ 'satans' as another category-genitive. Flag for parallels.
Possibly Lyc. ⲇ for ⲣ on ⲣⲉϥ-ⲟⲩⲱⲍ '(one who) adds' or ⲁϩ-ⲟⲩⲱⲍ 'he added/proceeded' (cf. accumulated ϩⲟⲩⲱⲍ 'add' and ⲁϩⲟⲩⲱⲍ ⲁⲧⲟⲟⲧϥ̄ 'continue' in glossary). Used in temporal-progressive narrative.
Relative ⲉⲥ- + ϯ-ⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'give a sign' (cf. accumulated ⲣⲉϥϯⲙⲉⲓⲛⲉ 'sign-giver'). The ϭ̄ may be a Lyc. graphic variant or contraction. Used of the substance that 'gives sign for the All.'
